versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־יִ֠הְיֶה לַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַלְוִיִּ֜ם כָּל־שֵׁ֧בֶט לֵוִ֛י חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִשֵּׁ֧י יְהוָ֛ה וְנַחֲלָת֖וֹ יֹאכֵלֽוּן׃

controles.web: The priests the Levites, all the tribe of Levi, shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the offerings of Yahweh made by fire and his portion.
controles.kjv: The priests the Levites, and all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel: they shall eat the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and his inheritance.
controles.livre: Os sacerdotes levitas, toda a tribo de Levi, não terão parte nem herança com Israel; das ofertas acendidas ao SENHOR, e da herança dele comerão.

versos.hebraico: וְנַחֲלָ֥ה לֹא־יִֽהְיֶה־לּ֖וֹ בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֶחָ֑יו יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־לֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers. Yahweh is their inheritance, as he has spoken to them.
controles.kjv: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren: the Lord is their inheritance, as he hath said unto them.
controles.livre: Não terão, pois, herança entre seus irmãos: o SENHOR é a sua herança, como ele lhes disse.

versos.hebraico: וְזֶ֡ה יִהְיֶה֩ מִשְׁפַּ֨ט הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים מֵאֵ֣ת הָעָ֗ם מֵאֵ֛ת זֹבְחֵ֥י הַזֶּ֖בַח אִם־שׁ֣וֹר אִם־שֶׂ֑ה וְנָתַן֙ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן הַזְּרֹ֥עַ וְהַלְּחָיַ֖יִם וְהַקֵּבָֽה׃

controles.web: This shall be the priests’ due from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep, that they shall give to the priest the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the inner parts.
controles.kjv: And this shall be the priest’s due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the maw.
controles.livre: E este será o direito dos sacerdotes da parte do povo, dos que oferecerem em sacrifício boi ou cordeiro: darão ao sacerdote a retaguarda, e as queixadas, e o estômago.

versos.hebraico: רֵאשִׁ֨ית דְּגָֽנְךָ֜ תִּֽירֹשְׁךָ֣ וְיִצְהָרֶ֗ךָ וְרֵאשִׁ֛ית גֵּ֥ז צֹאנְךָ֖ תִּתֶּן־לּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep, you shall give him.
controles.kjv: The firstfruit also of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.
controles.livre: As primícias de teus grãos, de teu vinho, e de teu azeite, e as primícias da lã de tuas ovelhas lhe darás:

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י ב֗וֹ בָּחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מִכָּל־שְׁבָטֶ֑יךָ לַעֲמֹ֨ד לְשָׁרֵ֧ת בְּשֵׁם־יְהוָ֛ה ה֥וּא וּבָנָ֖יו כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃ס

controles.web: For Yahweh your God has chosen him out of all your tribes, to stand to minister in Yahweh’s name, him and his sons for ever.
controles.kjv: For the Lord thy God hath chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the Lord, him and his sons for ever.
controles.livre: Porque o escolheu o SENHOR teu Deus de todas tuas tribos, para que esteja para ministrar ao nome do SENHOR, ele e seus filhos para sempre.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יָבֹ֨א הַלֵּוִ֜י מֵאַחַ֤ד שְׁעָרֶ֨יךָ֙ מִכָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־ה֖וּא גָּ֣ר שָׁ֑ם וּבָא֙ בְּכָל־אַוַּ֣ת נַפְשׁ֔וֹ אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: If a Levite comes from any of your gates out of all Israel, where he lives as a foreigner, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place which Yahweh shall choose;
controles.kjv: And if a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel, where he sojourned, and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the Lord shall choose;
controles.livre: E quando o levita sair de alguma de tuas cidades de todo Israel, onde houver peregrinado, e vier com todo desejo de sua alma ao lugar que o SENHOR escolher,

versos.hebraico: וְשֵׁרֵ֕ת בְּשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו כְּכָל־אֶחָיו֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם הָעֹמְדִ֥ים שָׁ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: then he shall minister in the name of Yahweh his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Then he shall minister in the name of the Lord his God, as all his brethren the Levites do, which stand there before the Lord.
controles.livre: Ministrará ao nome do SENHOR seu Deus, como todos os seus irmãos os levitas que estiverem ali diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: חֵ֥לֶק כְּחֵ֖לֶק יֹאכֵ֑לוּ לְבַ֥ד מִמְכָּרָ֖יו עַל־הָאָבֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: They shall have like portions to eat, in addition to that which comes from the sale of his family possessions.
controles.kjv: They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony.
controles.livre: Porção como a porção dos outros comerão, além de seus patrimônios.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ בָּ֣א אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֑ךְ לֹֽא־תִלְמַ֣ד לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כְּתוֹעֲבֹ֖ת הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָהֵֽם׃

controles.web: When you have come into the land which Yahweh your God gives you, you shall not learn to imitate the abominations of those nations.
controles.kjv: When thou art come into the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.
controles.livre: Quando houveres entrado na terra que o SENHOR teu Deus te dá, não aprenderás a fazer segundo as abominações daquelas nações.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־יִמָּצֵ֣א בְךָ֔ מַעֲבִ֥יר בְּנֽוֹ־וּבִתּ֖וֹ בָּאֵ֑שׁ קֹסֵ֣ם קְסָמִ֔ים מְעוֹנֵ֥ן וּמְנַחֵ֖שׁ וּמְכַשֵּֽׁף׃

controles.web: There shall not be found with you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, one who uses divination, one who practices sorcery, or an enchanter, or a sorcerer,
controles.kjv: There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch,
controles.livre: Não seja achado em ti quem faça passar seu filho ou sua filha pelo fogo, nem praticante de adivinhações, nem agoureiro, nem interpretador de presságios, nem feiticeiro,

versos.hebraico: וְחֹבֵ֖ר חָ֑בֶר וְשֹׁאֵ֥ל אוֹב֙ וְיִדְּעֹנִ֔י וְדֹרֵ֖שׁ אֶל־הַמֵּתִֽים׃

controles.web: or a charmer, or a consulter with a familiar spirit, or a wizard, or a necromancer.
controles.kjv: Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.
controles.livre: Nem quem fale encantamentos, nem quem pergunte a espírito, nem mágico, nem quem pergunte aos mortos.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־תוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה כָּל־עֹ֣שֵׂה אֵ֑לֶּה וּבִגְלַל֙ הַתּוֹעֵבֹ֣ת הָאֵ֔לֶּה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מוֹרִ֥ישׁ אוֹתָ֖ם מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: For whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh. Because of these abominations, Yahweh your God drives them out from before you.
controles.kjv: For all that do these things are an abomination unto the Lord: and because of these abominations the Lord thy God doth drive them out from before thee.
controles.livre: Porque é abominação ao SENHOR qualquer um que faz estas coisas, e por estas abominações o SENHOR teu Deus as expulsou de diante de ti.

versos.hebraico: תָּמִ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה עִ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ס

controles.web: You shall be perfect with Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt be perfect with the Lord thy God.
controles.livre: Serás íntegro com o SENHOR teu Deus.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י׀ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ יוֹרֵ֣שׁ אוֹתָ֔ם אֶל־מְעֹנְנִ֥ים וְאֶל־קֹסְמִ֖ים יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ וְאַתָּ֕ה לֹ֣א כֵ֔ן נָ֛תַן לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners; but as for you, Yahweh your God has not allowed you so to do.
controles.kjv: For these nations, which thou shalt possess, hearkened unto observers of times, and unto diviners: but as for thee, the Lord thy God hath not suffered thee so to do.
controles.livre: Pois essas nações que herdarás ouviam encantadores e feiticeiros. A ti, porém, o SENHOR teu Deus não te permitiu isso.

versos.hebraico: נָבִ֨יא מִקִּרְבְּךָ֤ מֵאַחֶ֨יךָ֙ כָּמֹ֔נִי יָקִ֥ים לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אֵלָ֖יו תִּשְׁמָעֽוּן׃

controles.web: Yahweh your God will raise up to you a prophet from your midst, of your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.
controles.kjv: The Lord thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
controles.livre: O SENHOR teu Deus suscitará para ti um Profeta do meio de ti, de teus irmãos, como eu; a ele deverás ouvir.

versos.hebraico: כְּכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁאַ֜לְתָּ מֵעִ֨ם יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ בְּחֹרֵ֔ב בְּי֥וֹם הַקָּהָ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹ֣א אֹסֵ֗ף לִשְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ אֶת־קוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י וְאֶת־הָאֵ֨שׁ הַגְּדֹלָ֥ה הַזֹּ֛את לֹֽא־אֶרְאֶ֥ה ע֖וֹד וְלֹ֥א אָמֽוּת׃

controles.web: This is according to all that you desired of Yahweh your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, “Let me not hear again the voice of Yahweh my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I not die.”
controles.kjv: According to all that thou desiredst of the Lord thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the Lord my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die not.
controles.livre: Conforme tudo o que pediste ao SENHOR teu Deus em Horebe no dia da assembleia, dizendo: Não volte eu a ouvir a voz do SENHOR meu Deus, nem veja eu mais este grande fogo, para que não morra;

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י הֵיטִ֖יבוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽרוּ׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to me, “They have well said that which they have spoken.
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto me, They have well spoken that which they have spoken.
controles.livre: e o SENHOR me disse: Bem disseram.

versos.hebraico: נָבִ֨יא אָקִ֥ים לָהֶ֛ם מִקֶּ֥רֶב אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם כָּמ֑וֹךָ וְנָתַתִּ֤י דְבָרַי֙ בְּפִ֔יו וְדִבֶּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲצַוֶּֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: I will raise them up a prophet from among their brothers, like you. I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I shall command him.
controles.kjv: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him.
controles.livre: Profeta lhes suscitarei do meio de seus irmãos, como tu; e porei minhas palavras em sua boca, e ele lhes falará tudo o que eu lhe mandar.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֗ה הָאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־יִשְׁמַע֙ אֶל־דְּבָרַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְדַבֵּ֖ר בִּשְׁמִ֑י אָנֹכִ֖י אֶדְרֹ֥שׁ מֵעִמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: It shall happen, that whoever will not listen to my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.
controles.livre: Mas será, que qualquer um que não ouvir minhas palavras que ele falar em meu nome, eu lhe exigirei prestar contas.

versos.hebraico: אַ֣ךְ הַנָּבִ֡יא אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָזִיד֩ לְדַבֵּ֨ר דָּבָ֜ר בִּשְׁמִ֗י אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־צִוִּיתִיו֙ לְדַבֵּ֔ר וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר יְדַבֵּ֔ר בְּשֵׁ֖ם אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וּמֵ֖ת הַנָּבִ֥יא הַהֽוּא׃

controles.web: But the prophet who speaks a word presumptuously in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that same prophet shall die.”
controles.kjv: But the prophet, which shall presume to speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or that shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.
controles.livre: Porém o profeta que presumir falar palavra em meu nome, que eu não lhe tenha mandado falar, ou que falar em nome de deuses alheios, o tal profeta morrerá.

versos.hebraico: וְכִ֥י תֹאמַ֖ר בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ אֵיכָה֙ נֵדַ֣ע אֶת־הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־דִבְּר֖וֹ יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: You may say in your heart, “How shall we know the word which Yahweh has not spoken?”
controles.kjv: And if thou say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the Lord hath not spoken?
controles.livre: E se disseres em teu coração: Como conheceremos a palavra que o SENHOR não houver falado?

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁר֩ יְדַבֵּ֨ר הַנָּבִ֜יא בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֗ה וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֤ה הַדָּבָר֙ וְלֹ֣א יָב֔וֹא ה֣וּא הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־דִבְּר֖וֹ יְהוָ֑ה בְּזָדוֹן֙ דִּבְּר֣וֹ הַנָּבִ֔יא לֹ֥א תָג֖וּר מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃ס

controles.web: When a prophet speaks in Yahweh’s name, if the thing doesn’t follow, nor happen, that is the thing which Yahweh has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You shall not be afraid of him.
controles.kjv: When a prophet speaketh in the name of the Lord, if the thing follow not, nor come to pass, that is the thing which the Lord hath not spoken, but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously: thou shalt not be afraid of him.
controles.livre: Quando o profeta falar em nome do SENHOR, e não for a tal coisa, nem vier, é palavra que o SENHOR não falou: com soberba a falou aquele profeta: não tenhas medo dele.
